title.en: Grammarly AI Writing Assistant: Pricing, Limits and Privacy
title.zh: Grammarly AI 写作助手：价格、额度与隐私边界
title.cn: Grammarly AI 写作助手：价格、额度与隐私边界

content.en: Use Grammarly for inline grammar, clarity, tone and rewriting support. Compare billing cadence, prompt limits, account-specific training controls, document storage and voice preservation before choosing it over a general AI chat.
content.zh: Grammarly 适合在现有写作界面中辅助语法、清晰度、语气和改写。选择它而不是通用 AI 对话工具前，应比较计费周期、提示额度、不同账号的训练控制、文档存储与原有表达保留情况。
content.cn: Grammarly 适合在现有写作界面中辅助语法、清晰度、语气和改写。选择它而不是通用 AI 对话工具前，应比较计费周期、提示额度、不同账号的训练控制、文档存储与原有表达保留情况。

detail.en:
Choose Grammarly when the main job is reviewing and improving writing inside documents, browsers and supported apps rather than starting every task in a general AI chat. Its writing assistant covers grammar, clarity, tone, rewriting and related checks, while Superhuman Go is a separate optional assistant. The company is now Superhuman Platform Inc., but Grammarly remains the canonical writing product and should not be merged with Go, Mail or Docs. [Official writing assistant](https://www.grammarly.com/ai-writing-assistant) · [Product identity](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/40707200788493-What-is-Superhuman).

Pricing checked September 20, 2026: Free is USD 0 and includes 100 AI prompts per month. The plans page displays Pro at USD 12 per month when billed annually, with a seven-day trial and 2,000 prompts per member per month. The pricing support article separately lists USD 30 monthly, USD 60 quarterly and USD 144 annually; regional checkout prices can differ. Enterprise is contact-sales and adds unlimited prompts per member plus organization controls. Keep the annual effective monthly figure, total annual charge and flexible billing separate. [Plans](https://www.grammarly.com/plans) · [Pro billing](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000090011-How-much-does-Grammarly-Pro-cost).

Privacy depends on account type and settings. Product Improvement and Training is enabled by default for individual accounts and directly purchased multi-user Pro accounts, with an opt-out. Sales-managed Enterprise, Business, Pro and Education accounts have it disabled by default. A statement that Grammarly either always or never trains on customer content would therefore be misleading. [Training control](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/25555503115277-Product-Improvement-and-Training-Control).

Service processing and model training are different questions. Grammarly says prompts and relevant context can be shared with vetted LLM service providers to deliver features, while those providers may not train on the content. Documents created in Grammarly Editor remain stored until the user deletes them or the account or contract ends. Sensitive-field exclusion is best effort, not an absolute guarantee. [Privacy FAQ](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/20916119474829-Privacy-and-security-FAQs).

Grammarly and Superhuman Go cannot both be the active desktop writing experience in the documented setup. Enabling Go can replace Grammarly's generative interface in supported clients, and availability varies. Teams should decide whether they need focused inline assistance or a broader contextual assistant. [Grammarly and Go together](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45976306096781-How-to-use-Grammarly-and-Superhuman-Go-for-Windows-and-Mac-together).

Independent evidence establishes durable adoption, not guaranteed quality. The Chrome Web Store reports 40 million users, 43.1 thousand ratings and a 4.5 score, while G2 shows more than 13 thousand reviews. Trustpilot is materially lower and includes cancellation, renewal and refund complaints. Use those signals to test suggestion acceptance, retained voice, false corrections and billing clarity. [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/grammarly-ai-writing-assi/kbfnbcaeplbcioakkpcpgfkobkghlhen) · [G2 reviews](https://www.g2.com/de/products/grammarly/reviews) · [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.grammarly.com).

Run a seven-day trial on real emails, long documents, technical terms and non-native English writing. Record accepted and rejected suggestions, meaning changes, editing time, prompt use and retained voice. AI detection, plagiarism checks, rewrites and generated text are decision aids, not authoritative proof. The Gr artwork is an AI Best Tool editorial identifier, not Grammarly's official logo or a product screenshot.
detail.zh:
当主要任务是在文档、浏览器和受支持应用中复核并改善已有文字，而不是每次都从通用 AI 对话开始时，可以选择 Grammarly。它覆盖语法、清晰度、语气、改写及相关检查；Superhuman Go 是另一种可选助手。公司现名为 Superhuman Platform Inc.，但 Grammarly 仍是独立写作产品，不应与 Go、Mail 或 Docs 合并。[官方写作助手](https://www.grammarly.com/ai-writing-assistant) · [产品身份](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/40707200788493-What-is-Superhuman)。

2026-09-20 价格核验：Free 为 0 美元，每月含 100 个 AI prompts。套餐页显示 Pro 年付折算每月 12 美元，含 7 天试用和每位成员每月 2,000 个 prompts。价格支持文章另列月付 30 美元、季度付 60 美元和年付 144 美元；地区结账价格可能不同。Enterprise 需联系销售，包含每位成员无限 prompts 和组织控制。年付月均价、年度总价与灵活计费必须分开表达。[套餐](https://www.grammarly.com/plans) · [Pro 计费](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000090011-How-much-does-Grammarly-Pro-cost)。

隐私取决于账号类型和设置。个人账号及直接购买的多人 Pro 账号默认开启 Product Improvement and Training，可以关闭；销售管理的 Enterprise、Business、Pro 和 Education 账号默认关闭。因此，笼统声称 Grammarly 始终使用或从不使用客户内容训练都会误导。[训练控制](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/25555503115277-Product-Improvement-and-Training-Control)。

服务处理与模型训练不是同一问题。Grammarly 表示提示词和相关上下文可能交给经过审核的 LLM 服务商处理，但服务商不得用内容训练模型。在 Grammarly Editor 创建的文档会存储到用户删除，或账号/合同终止。敏感字段排除属于 best effort，不是绝对保证。[隐私 FAQ](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/20916119474829-Privacy-and-security-FAQs)。

在官方描述的桌面设置中，Grammarly 与 Superhuman Go 不能同时作为激活的写作体验。启用 Go 可能替换受支持客户端中的 Grammarly 生成式界面，且可用性因客户端而异。团队应先判断需要聚焦的行内辅助，还是更广泛的上下文助手。[Grammarly 与 Go](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45976306096781-How-to-use-Grammarly-and-Superhuman-Go-for-Windows-and-Mac-together)。

独立证据证明长期采用度，但不保证质量。Chrome Web Store 显示 4,000 万用户、4.31 万条评分和 4.5 分；G2 有超过 1.3 万条评论。Trustpilot 明显更低，并出现取消、续费和退款摩擦。应把这些信号转为建议接受率、语气保留、误改和账单清晰度测试。[Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/grammarly-ai-writing-assi/kbfnbcaeplbcioakkpcpgfkobkghlhen) · [G2 评论](https://www.g2.com/de/products/grammarly/reviews) · [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.grammarly.com)。

建议用真实邮件、长文档、技术术语和非母语英语写作进行 7 天试用，记录接受与拒绝建议、含义变化、编辑时间、prompt 消耗和语气保留。AI 检测、抄袭检查、改写和生成文本只是决策辅助，不是权威证明。页面 Gr 图形是本站自制编辑识别图，不是 Grammarly 官方 Logo 或产品截图。
